prompt:
Classify each of the following 20 items into exactly one of these labels: billing|technical|account|other.
One label per line, exactly 20 lines, nothing else.

1. My credit card was charged twice for last month.
2. The app crashes when I open settings.
3. I cannot log in to my account.
4. What are your business hours?
5. Please refund my overpayment.
6. Error 500 when uploading a file.
7. Reset my password link expired.
8. Do you support SSO?
9. Invoice PDF is missing.
10. Sync fails with timeout.
11. Change my email address.
12. Where is the documentation?
13. Subscription renewed but no receipt.
14. Dark mode not working.
15. Locked out after failed attempts.
16. Can I export my data?
17. Discount code not applied.
18. API returns 404 on /users.
19. Delete my account please.
20. Thanks for great service.
